en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-34 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Sahl ibn Zyad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Sa’id al-Ahvazi, on the authority of Ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of Himad, on the authority of Al-Halabi that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said, “
The people are divided into six groups: weak people; those who accept the religion; those who are unstable; those who confess to their sins; the Nasabites ; and the believers.”
